maps.name: Jungle Temple
maps.description: A classic jungle temple map with wide corridors and open courtyards. Great for beginners learning the basics of tagging and dodging.
tips: Stay near the outer edges to avoid getting cornered
Use the temple pillars as cover when being chased
The central courtyard is dangerous — avoid it when holding the bomb

maps.name: Treehouse Village
maps.description: A vertical map with interconnected treehouses and rope bridges. Requires good movement skills including wall jumps and vine swings.
tips: Master wall jumping to access the upper platforms quickly
Rope bridges are choke points — avoid them when holding the bomb
Drop down from treehouses to escape chasers

maps.name: Crystal Caves
maps.description: An underground cave system with narrow tunnels and glowing crystals. Limited visibility makes stealth a viable strategy.
tips: Use the dark corners to hide when holding the bomb
Crystal formations block line of sight — use them to juke chasers
Memorize the tunnel layout for quick escapes

maps.name: Lava Fortress
maps.description: A dangerous fortress surrounded by lava pits. Environmental hazards add an extra layer of danger — fall in and you're eliminated regardless of the bomb.
tips: Never stop moving on narrow lava bridges
Push opponents toward lava edges when chasing
The elevated platforms are safe zones but easy to get trapped on

maps.name: Sky Islands
maps.description: Floating islands high in the sky with gaps between them. One wrong jump means elimination. The most movement-skill-intensive map.
tips: Always have an escape route planned before the bomb comes to you
Long jumps between islands are risky but rewarding
Stay on the larger islands — small platforms are death traps

maps.name: Grid Arena
maps.description: A flat, grid-based arena with no elevation changes. Pure tag gameplay with no environmental distractions. Popular for competitive duels.
tips: Keep moving in unpredictable patterns
The flat layout means nowhere to hide — pure speed wins
Great for practicing basic tag and dodge mechanics

maps.name: Factory
maps.description: An industrial factory map with conveyor belts, moving platforms, and machinery. Dynamic elements keep every round feeling fresh.
tips: Use conveyor belts to gain speed when fleeing
Moving platforms can separate you from chasers
Listen for machinery sounds to predict platform movements

maps.name: Ancient Ruins
maps.description: Crumbling ancient ruins with collapsing floors and hidden passages. The map changes during the round as structures break apart.
